drills.q: An Azure Function gets 401 from Key Vault seconds after a role assignment was added. First two things you check?
drills.a: Whether the grant went through a group (claim cache ~24h) and whether the instance needs restart/remint; also confirm RBAC propagation delay of minutes.

drills.q: Name the three systems involved when a user calls an API backed by Azure SQL.
drills.a: Entra ID issues tokens; Conditional Access gates issuance; data-plane authorization checks the resource side (SQL permissions / data-plane roles).

drills.q: Why does Microsoft recommend user-assigned identities over system-assigned now?
drills.a: Lifecycle decoupling: pre-provision role assignments before compute, survive blue/green replacement, one identity shared per workload pattern; avoids Entra object-quota churn from rapid create/delete.

drills.q: A daemon hits IMDS 429s during scale-out burst. Root cause and fix?
drills.a: MI category limit ~20 req/s + 5 concurrent; fix is minting once per process and reusing the token for its full lifetime, not fetching per request.

drills.q: Explain why 'shorten tokens' failed as a revocation strategy and what replaced it.
drills.a: It taxed legitimate users while attackers use stolen tokens immediately; refresh/session policies retired Jan 2021; CAE revokes near-real-time on events and lets tokens live up to 28h.

drills.q: Your Terraform apply recreates a VM and the app loses all access despite identical config. Why?
drills.a: System-assigned MI: new VM = new principalId = zero role assignments. Fix with user-assigned MI or re-run assignment against new principalId in same apply.

drills.q: One admin user fails authz everywhere; they're in 230 groups. Explain and fix.
drills.a: JWT group overage (>~200): _claim_names indirection instead of inline groups. Handle overage via Graph transitive lookup or switch to direct app-role assignments.

drills.q: How would you collapse hundreds of tenant-scoped storage role assignments without widening access?
drills.a: ABAC role assignment conditions on Blob (prefix/tenant attribute matching) so one role covers many tenants within enforced boundaries.

drills.q: CI pipeline still stores an Entra client secret. Migrate it.
drills.a: GitHub Actions OIDC federation: register app/MI federated credential trusting the repo's OIDC issuer+subject, swap azure/login to use OIDC, delete secret; cap note: max 20 FICs per app.

drills.q: Design least-privilege RBAC and identity for a CI/CD pipeline deploying across dev/staging/prod subscriptions, and explain why subscription-wide Contributor is the wrong shortcut.
drills.a: Use a user-assigned managed identity or Workload ID Federation (OIDC, no stored secret) with Contributor scoped per-environment resource group, never subscription-wide or Owner; gate prod with human-approval pipeline steps and PIM-eligible break-glass roles for operators. Subscription-wide Contributor means a single compromised pipeline identity can touch every environment including prod from one foothold, violating blast-radius containment.

drills.q: State the exact numeric limits for managed identity attachment and creation rate.
drills.a: A user-assigned identity attaches to up to 1,000 resources; a single resource can have up to 20 user-assigned identities. Creation is rate-limited to 400 ops/20s per tenant/region and 80 ops/20s per subscription/region.
